sendtofriend.title: SHARE YOUR SCORE
sendtofriend.challengeafriend: Challenge a friend to play Championsheeps - Can they beat your score?
sendtofriend.sharedescription:
Fill in the details and click 'Send' to email your friend - remember to ask them first.

We won't keep your or your friend's email or use it for anything else. You can look at the privacy-statement if you want to know more.
